Confidence intervals for
differences of standardized regression slopes
are generated using
the `DiffBetaNB()` function from the `betaNB` package.
In this example,
we use the data set and the model used in
[betaNB: Example Using the BetaNB Function](example-beta-nb.html).


``` r
library(betaNB)
```




``` r
df <- betaNB::nas1982
```

### Regression

Fit the regression model using the `lm()` function.


``` r
object <- lm(QUALITY ~ NARTIC + PCTGRT + PCTSUPP, data = df)
```

### Nonparametric Bootstrap


``` r
nb <- NB(object)
```

### Differences of Standardized Regression Slopes

#### Normal-Theory Approach


``` r
out <- DiffBetaNB(nb, alpha = 0.05)
```

## Methods

### summary

Summary of the results of `DiffBetaNB()`.

#### Percentile Confidence Intervals


``` r
summary(out, type = "pc")
#> Call:
#> DiffBetaNB(object = nb, alpha = 0.05)
#> 
#> Differences of standardized regression slopes
#> type = "pc"
#>                   est     se    R    2.5%  97.5%
#> NARTIC-PCTGRT  0.1037 0.1315 5000 -0.1527 0.3617
#> NARTIC-PCTSUPP 0.2319 0.1233 5000 -0.0099 0.4764
#> PCTGRT-PCTSUPP 0.1282 0.1290 5000 -0.1187 0.3857
```

#### Bias Corrected Confidence Intervals


``` r
summary(out, type = "bc")
#> Call:
#> DiffBetaNB(object = nb, alpha = 0.05)
#> 
#> Differences of standardized regression slopes
#> type = "bc"
#>                   est     se    R    2.5%  97.5%
#> NARTIC-PCTGRT  0.1037 0.1315 5000 -0.1568 0.3583
#> NARTIC-PCTSUPP 0.2319 0.1233 5000 -0.0112 0.4748
#> PCTGRT-PCTSUPP 0.1282 0.1290 5000 -0.1173 0.3872
```

#### Bias Corrected and Accelerated Confidence Intervals


``` r
summary(out, type = "bca")
#> Call:
#> DiffBetaNB(object = nb, alpha = 0.05)
#> 
#> Differences of standardized regression slopes
#> type = "bca"
#>                   est     se    R    2.5%  97.5%
#> NARTIC-PCTGRT  0.1037 0.1315 5000 -0.1586 0.3569
#> NARTIC-PCTSUPP 0.2319 0.1233 5000 -0.0135 0.4706
#> PCTGRT-PCTSUPP 0.1282 0.1290 5000 -0.1085 0.4015
```

### coef

Return the vector of estimates.


``` r
coef(out)
#>  NARTIC-PCTGRT NARTIC-PCTSUPP PCTGRT-PCTSUPP 
#>      0.1036564      0.2318974      0.1282410
```

### vcov

Return the sampling covariance matrix.


``` r
vcov(out)
#>                NARTIC-PCTGRT NARTIC-PCTSUPP PCTGRT-PCTSUPP
#> NARTIC-PCTGRT    0.017287469    0.007921433   -0.009366036
#> NARTIC-PCTSUPP   0.007921433    0.015192662    0.007271229
#> PCTGRT-PCTSUPP  -0.009366036    0.007271229    0.016637265
```

### confint

Return confidence intervals.

#### Percentile Confidence Intervals


``` r
confint(out, level = 0.95, type = "pc")
#>                       2.5 %    97.5 %
#> NARTIC-PCTGRT  -0.152664597 0.3617406
#> NARTIC-PCTSUPP -0.009926949 0.4764183
#> PCTGRT-PCTSUPP -0.118704673 0.3857051
```

#### Bias Corrected Confidence Intervals


``` r
confint(out, level = 0.95, type = "bc")
#>                      2.5 %    97.5 %
#> NARTIC-PCTGRT  -0.15675616 0.3583040
#> NARTIC-PCTSUPP -0.01117065 0.4748241
#> PCTGRT-PCTSUPP -0.11731552 0.3872389
```

#### Bias Corrected and Accelerated Confidence Intervals


``` r
confint(out, level = 0.95, type = "bca")
#>                      2.5 %    97.5 %
#> NARTIC-PCTGRT  -0.15861806 0.3569009
#> NARTIC-PCTSUPP -0.01346041 0.4706113
#> PCTGRT-PCTSUPP -0.10845468 0.4015150
```
